column1: ## Section name: ".mercury_to_sass_map" (MERC_MAP_SECNAME), suffixed with the text-section name; sh_info = SASS section index.
## A DWARF-line-program-style byte-code state machine emitted by the ptxas master ELF emitter (sub_1C9F280) + capsule descriptor builder (sub_1C9C300).
## It records the correspondence Mercury-instruction-offset <-> SASS-instruction-offset so the driver/debugger can relabel Mercury PCs to SASS PCs after finalization.
## Opcode/header identifiers and the MPE/SASS sizes are corroborated binary-side (MPE packet = 32B, SASS inst = 16B).
## --- OPCODES (1 byte opcode + LEB128 args; state machine) ---
